items.title: Joint law of the fixed-location radial levels

source.anchor: §4.2 Lemma 4.4 and §6.1 fixed-location Gaussian calculation immediately before Eq. (51)
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, CC BY 4.0. Samplinglib spells out the intermediate joint law and its measured product construction.

items.statement: Fix one deterministic spatial point x=(x₀,…,xₕ). Draw the actual full ordered coefficient vector from its unconditioned standard Gaussian law. The vector of scalar radial fields at x has the product of the centered Gaussian laws with variances n C_i(x)² v_i. In particular the fields are mutually independent, including any point-mass factors.
assumptions: The paper takes n large and chooses h from n. This isolated finite product law holds for every positive n and natural h; it does not extend admissibility or the lower-bound regime.

Each level uses the tail x_i,…,x_h of the same fixed deterministic x and only its own coefficient blocks, one ordered tensor block for each permitted even p. The cutoff and zero-block extension are literal.

The only randomness is the unconditioned joint Euclidean coefficient Gaussian. The marginal variances need not be positive. No property of a trajectory, adaptive query, or conditioning event is assumed.

formulae.label: Exact cutoff from footnote 2 and Eq. (16)
Angular model and variance scale
formulae.tex: \begin{gathered}K=2^{74(h+1)},\quad P=2^{64(h+1)},\quad S_i=\sum_{j=0}^{h-i}K^j,\quad \mathcal P=\{4,6,\ldots,P\},\\ a_{i,p}=\frac1{p^4S_i^2\sqrt{(h-i+1)\log(2PS_i)}},\quad v_i=\sum_{p\in\mathcal P}a_{i,p}^2,\\ \psi_i(u)=\bigotimes_{j=i}^h u_j^{\otimes K^{j-i}},\qquad F_i^\Xi(u)=\sum_{p\in\mathcal P}\sqrt n\,a_{i,p}\langle\Xi_{i,p},\psi_i(u)^{\otimes p}\rangle.\end{gathered}

formulae.label: Actual one-point law
formulae.tex: \begin{gathered}H_i^\Xi(x)=\begin{cases}0 & \exists j\ge i:\ x_j=0,\\C_i(x)\,F_i^\Xi((x_j/\|x_j\|)_{j=i}^h)&\text{otherwise},\end{cases}\\ H_i^\Xi(x)\sim\mathcal N(0,n C_i(x)^2 v_i),\qquad \mathcal N(0,0)=\delta_0.\end{gathered}

obligations.label: Regroup the actual independent degree coefficient blocks by level
Derive the joint product of the exact radial marginals

bindings.boundary: Fixed-location joint law of the actual scalar levels. Not joint in x, not a proof of the weighted Gaussian law or MGF in Eq. (51), not earlier coefficient sigma-field independence or a conditional expectation identity, and no mass estimate or lower bound.

assumption_deltas.source: A fixed x in the paper's hard-family parameter regime.
assumption_deltas.lean: All positive n and natural h, and one full deterministic x for this isolated identity.
assumption_deltas.reason: Coordinate grouping and finite pushforward do not use the asymptotic parameter choices. No extension of the hard family is claimed.

assumption_deltas.source: Fixed-point degree fields are independent centered Gaussians with exact cutoffs, then summed over degrees for each i.
assumption_deltas.lean: The same actual coefficient vector and cutoffs give the exact product of the scalar level marginals.
assumption_deltas.reason: Each group of degrees is disjoint and uses the same x tail and literal zero convention. Product pushforward proves mutual independence, not only pairwise decorrelation.

assumption_deltas.source: The variance calculation leaves finite grouping and measurability implicit.
assumption_deltas.lean: No added regularity, integrability or independence hypotheses; actual measurable level maps and product laws are proved.
assumption_deltas.reason: For fixed x each level is constant zero or a finite linear combination of continuous coefficient projections.
